# Cylinder [Area of Effect]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Areas of Effect](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#CylinderAreaofEffect)*

A Cylinder is an [area of effect](Area-of-Effect.md) that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located at the center of the circular top or bottom of the Cylinder. The effect that creates a Cylinder specifies the radius of the Cylinder's base and the Cylinder's height.

A Cylinder's point of origin is included in the area of effect.
